rule: Paper metrics are external evidence and never Roadwatch metrics.

studies.title: Slicing Aided Hyper Inference and Fine-tuning for Small Object Detection
studies.checkpoint: Official repository links benchmark weights; exact Roadwatch-compatible checkpoint NOT VERIFIED
studies.dataset_protocol: VisDrone and xView object detection; subject split not applicable
studies.camera_modality: large still images, not in-cabin video
studies.main_metrics: COCO AP improvements reported for sliced inference/fine-tuning; not Event F1
studies.compute_speed: Extra tile passes trade latency for resolution; Roadwatch speed must be measured
studies.limitations: Domain and task differ; more tiles can create duplicate/negative proposals
studies.roadwatch_adaptation: overlapping original-resolution driver ROI tiles plus coordinate merge/NMS
studies.hypothesis: fixed phone checkpoint yields more valid small-phone proposals without excessive negative-frame FP
studies.cost_risk: low engineering cost, medium runtime and FP risk

studies.title: DualScope: Capturing Critical Spatial and Temporal Cues for Distracted Driving Activity Recognition
studies.official_code: https://github.com/Qqqzzjsupr3me/DualScope (URL supplied by paper/prompt; unavailable during verification)
studies.dataset_protocol: Driver-activity recognition protocol in paper; exact subject-disjoint status NOT VERIFIED
studies.main_metrics: classification metrics in paper, not Roadwatch event metrics
studies.limitations: SAM distillation and temporal pyramid add training/data cost
studies.roadwatch_adaptation: lightweight hand/phone/face crops, frame differences and causal multi-scale temporal features
studies.hypothesis: behavior-centric spatial and motion cues improve SAFE/PHONE/OTHER separation
studies.cost_risk: high fitting cost and overfitting risk; blocked now

studies.title: DriveCLIP: A CLIP-Based General Framework for Distracted Driver Recognition
studies.venue_year: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems 2024
studies.dataset_protocol: DMD, State Farm, SynDD1 and SAM-DD; exact subject-disjoint details must be checked per script
studies.camera_modality: RGB frames; repository README describes frame sampling and per-frame prediction
studies.main_metrics: image/frame recognition metrics, not Roadwatch Event F1
studies.limitations: official repository is frame-based and links a separate VideoCLIP comparison
studies.roadwatch_adaptation: frozen CLIP embeddings with a fitted, provenance-locked small head
studies.hypothesis: semantic embeddings improve class separation and transfer
studies.cost_risk: medium compute; fitting and rights blocked

studies.title: ActionFormer: Localizing Moments of Actions with Transformers
studies.checkpoint: Official repository provides model zoo links
studies.license: Repository license present; exact terms NOT VERIFIED
studies.main_metrics: temporal localization mAP at IoU thresholds; not event P/R/F1
studies.compute_speed: repository recommends GPU with at least 12 GB for training

studies.roadwatch_adaptation: test a small causal TCN/boundary head before a full transformer

studies.title: Multi-Task Fusion for Driver Monitoring
studies.license: article open access; model/code license NOT VERIFIED

studies.limitations: three views are not always present in Roadwatch

studies.title: ByteTrack: Multi-Object Tracking by Associating Every Detection Box
studies.dataset_protocol: MOT17 and other pedestrian MOT benchmarks
studies.main_metrics: MOTA, IDF1, HOTA and FPS; not driver-role accuracy

studies.hypothesis: reduce fragmented phone tracks without assigning passenger phones to driver
